task.description: Implement EE-08 (Instance cancellation) per the design artefact in src/design/engine.md (EE-08 section). Implement cancelInstance in src/engine/instance.zig: atomic 8-step DB transaction (SELECT FOR UPDATE → cancel tasks → cancel timers → insert INSTANCE_CANCELLED event → update projection → COMMIT). Wire the POST /instances/:id/cancel route in src/api/routes/definitions.zig. Return HTTP 200 on success, HTTP 409 if already terminal (CANCELLED/COMPLETED/ERROR), HTTP 404 if not found. Run zig build and zig build test — both must exit 0.
acceptance_criteria: cancelInstance function implemented in src/engine/instance.zig per design artefact EE-08 section
POST /instances/:id/cancel route wired and returns HTTP 200 / 409 / 404 per EE-08 spec
Atomic transaction: tasks CANCELLED + timers CANCELLED + INSTANCE_CANCELLED event + projection update all in one TX
No open tasks/timers edge case handled correctly (event still appended)

result.summary: Implemented EE-08 (Instance cancellation): enhanced cancelInstance in src/engine/instance.zig with full 8-step atomic transaction (SELECT FOR UPDATE lock, task cancellation with ID collection, timer cancellation with ID collection, structured INSTANCE_CANCELLED event payload per design §5, projection update with current_nodes cleared and cancelled_at set). Added actor_id parameter per design §3.1. Added extractBranchIds and buildCancelPayload helper functions. Updated handleCancel in src/api/routes/instances.zig to pass actor_id. Both ACTIVE and ERROR instances are cancellable per OQ-EE08-1 resolution. zig build and zig build test both exit 0.
